description: Returns high and low tide predictions (time and height in meters) for Reykjavík and 49 other Icelandic harbours from tide.is (based on Icelandic Coast Guard Sjávarfallatöflur & TICON-4).

date.description: Target date (YYYY-MM-DD, defaults to today in Atlantic/Reykjavik).

port.description: Icelandic harbour name or ID (default Reykjavík; e.g. Akureyri, Ísafjörður, Vestmannaeyjar, Grindavík, Vík, Höfn).

name: get_tides
title: Get High & Low Tides for Icelandic Harbours
